rows.name: Round 364 - the five Ono-lab papers read properly. STAGE not duration is the hedgehog discriminator and it favours this subject; AXITINIB IS USED ROUTINELY TO PREVENT GROWTH PLATE FUSION IN NORMAL MICE, which reverses my own contraindication; and GH lowers the self-renewal fraction, which is the mechanism of its own tachyphylaxis

Round 365 - the VEGF class thickens the growth plate in five species including one human child, and that is the FAILURE phenotype, not the lever. The atlas closed this route on 2026-08-09 on the same paper and the closure never reached CLAUDE.md, so I nearly reopened it. Plus the composed kill - proliferation continues under blockade while output stops, so depletion runs at full rate for nothing

Round 368 - SYSTEMIC SMOOTHENED AGONISTS EXIST AND SYSTEMIC SAG POST-SOC EXPANDS THE STEM-CELL POOL BY 61 PER CENT, matching the local route on clonogenicity by the authors own comparison. The systemic length NULL this file has quoted for rounds is a 7-day experiment at n=7/5 whose femur confidence interval spans minus 2.03 to plus 6.23 mm - it is UNINFORMATIVE, NOT NULL - so THE ROUTE MUST BE LOCAL IS WITHDRAWN

R425: three decisions. NAVEPEGRITIDE goes IN, decided against CORR-195 rather than a population prior, because h_term is the ONLY term left in the identity with an approved obtainable agent. The SITE term is opened and its first-class finding is that the paediatric human vertebral physis has NEVER BEEN SAMPLED by anyone. And the loading prescription is JUMPING, not vibration - the atlas already held a controlled human height endpoint and never wrote it in the ledger, while vibration has none in any species

R426: movement worked to the end. The atlas already held a 17-node loading dose-response layer the ledger never carried. Optimising it SPLITS MOVEMENT INTO THREE DISSOCIABLE MECHANISMS, and the one R425 prescribed - IMPACT - is the one with a RANDOMISED HUMAN NULL at the identical dose, while the one nobody has ever prescribed - CHRONIC EXERCISE RAISING SOLUTE DELIVERY TO THE PLATE - has an internally controlled length endpoint in a normal animal and has never been tested in a human
gp130/STAT3 is the first axis found that controls the progenitor pool AND fusion timing together, postnatally and chondrocyte-autonomously - and its small molecule has a contested sign
The CNP axis is redundant with FGFR3 blockade in ONE of its two arms and not the other - and the non-redundant arm lands on the term the stack covers worst
PTHrP/IHH negative feedback loop

ROUND 255 - the GH verdict was wrong for THIS subject and the paper I used says so, and the untouched signalling was real. RARgamma is the most abundant retinoid receptor in the growth plate, its antagonist ALONE delays maturation and EXPANDS the plate, and it is the antidote to the exact failure mode of this atlas's own discharge step

ROUND 256 - the query run on the archived human plates. RARgamma is present in the human growth plate at 37 times the negative-control floor in 4 of 4 donors and is ENRICHED IN THE ROOT AND PROLIFERATIVE COMPARTMENTS rather than the hypertrophic one, both arms of the retinoid circuit are there - and SOST is BELOW the floor set by genes that have no business in cartilage, in every donor and every gate

ROUND 305 - cAMP is a height-setting second messenger in humans, anchored in BOTH directions by three genes and corroborated in mouse. GNAS -9.36 cm and ADCY6 -2.70 cm (make cAMP, loss shortens) against PDE3B +1.22 cm (degrades cAMP, loss lengthens) - and ADCY6 and PDE3B carry the SAME P value, 5.1e-13, with opposite signs and opposite roles. The whole apparatus is in the human growth plate. The one pharmacological test that failed is PTH1R, and PTH1R is also the one gene whose human sign is discordant

ROUND 306 - the operator asked for every drug on the cAMP axis and exactly what we need. The answer is that this is not a hypothesis: REDUCED cAMP/PKA SIGNALLING IS A NAMED HUMAN DISEASE FAMILY (iPPSD), every member has SHORT STATURE AND BRACHYDACTYLY, and BOTH DRUGGABLE PHOSPHODIESTERASES ARE IN IT AS GAIN-OF-FUNCTION SHORT-STATURE GENES. Plus the survey that decides which handle: of ~30 Gs-coupled receptors the human growth plate expresses essentially ONE, so receptor agonism is not the way in - PDE inhibition is

ROUND 307 - the full mechanistic map of cAMP in the growth plate, built to decide which node to drug. The answer is not the one the last two rounds were heading toward. cAMP SHORTENS BONE IN BOTH DIRECTIONS - the fifth band in this file - and the overshoot arm has a NAMED PATHWAY with a rescue experiment. Worse for this case specifically: raising cAMP raises CREB, and erdafitinib works by LOWERING CREB, so a cAMP-raiser partially opposes an arm already in the stack

ROUND 309 - I asked which cAMP pool PDE4B controls and the answer INVERTS ROUND 308. The direction of PDE4D in acrodysostosis is a live controversy I stated as fact in two rounds, and native patient fibroblasts say PDE4D activity is REDUCED with phospho-CREB RAISED. So chronic PDE4 inhibition phenocopies a -4.81 SDS short-stature dysplasia, by the exact mechanism round 307 warned about. cAMP IS NOT A SCALAR - the sign of the height effect depends on WHICH POOL, and abundance was the wrong criterion

ROUND 310 - the local-or-systemic question is DECIDED, by two independent tests, and the answer closes the cAMP axis for this case. PDE3B's PheWAS is dominated by LIPIDS at P=2e-60, forty orders of magnitude beyond its height signal, and at single-cell resolution PDE3B is 3.7-fold DEPLETED in chondrocytes relative to the other cells of the same tissue. The same test, run as its own control, finds NRK 83-fold chondrocyte- ENRICHED - the cleanest growth-plate-specific target in the atlas
The CNP axis mapped end to end against human growth plate expression - the ligand is absent, the receptor and the whole cilostazol chain are present, and that decides which agent belongs

ROUND 287 - all seventeen run, both directions, graph grepped before every claim. TWO PASS, ONE FAILS, AND FOURTEEN HAVE NEVER BEEN GIVEN A LENGTH ENDPOINT IN THE DIRECTION THAT WOULD HELP. But the sort has a structure nobody put there: EIGHT OF THE SEVENTEEN ARE EXTRACELLULAR MATRIX OR SECRETED MORPHOGEN-HANDLING PROTEINS, both passing genes are secreted antagonists, the single largest effect in the table is the matrix's own proteoglycan - and this atlas has 29 nodes on that gene, every one about DEFICIENCY. THE EXTRACELLULAR CONTROL OF MORPHOGEN AVAILABILITY IS A LAYER THIS FILE HAS NEVER NAMED

ROUND 295 - hypertrophic chondrocyte volume control, mapped. The atlas left its central claim marked "contested" while holding both papers that contest it; they measure different quantities and both are right, which names the lever class as SMALL OSMOLYTES rather than protein. And the one oral agent that has ever augmented endochondral growth - myo-inositol, absent from this atlas entirely - grew a rabbit mandible 4.7 per cent and did NOTHING to the femur. The reason its authors give for that null does NOT survive the human data - PIK3CD is expressed in the human growth plate - so the arm is unexplained rather than closed. And PIEZO1, top of the atlas's own height ranking, turns out to be hypertrophy-enriched in the human plate and never perturbed for length

R404: the corrected supply query run on all fourteen secreted load-bearing genes - four fail the receiver test, two are the wrong modality or redundant, one has a contested direction, and of the remaining five ONLY OSTEOLECTIN HAS EVER BEEN GIVEN TO AN ANIMAL

R405: SCUBE3 taken all the way down - the sufficiency experiment exists and used the recombinant protein, the mechanism is a CO-RECEPTOR which is the one architecture where supply is coherent, and an oncology programme is building a neutralising antibody against the exact protein

R409: the volume module worked in both directions - R408's chemistry optimism corrected within one round (KCC1 has ZERO chemical matter), the organic-osmolyte class SPLITS on localisation leaving BETAINE as the only obtainable member, CHST3 not CHST11 is the plate's sulfotransferase, and PIEZO1 loss is minus 2.46 cm in humans

R410: sulfate and CHST3 are ONE lever in series and only the supply step is actionable - CHST3 and CHST11 are zonally SEGREGATED in human tissue with CHST3 peaking in the hypertrophic zone while the sulfate importer falls, the desulfation route closes on three storage diseases, and the measurement that would decide the whole arm is a two-minute non-invasive scan nobody has pointed at a growth plate

R417: AEBP1 worked to the end - a monotone 35-row human allelic series with pLoF at +1.10 cm and the best-powered row at P=8.4e-15, a SECRETED protein peaking in PERICHONDRIUM and RESTING ZONE, acting on canonical Wnt at the one DEPTH that works. And it is a BAND: the osteoprogenitor knockout REDUCES body size and the biallelic human has osteoporosis and scoliosis. Third instance of R281's interior optimum, first with a large human heterozygous effect

ROUND 280 - the strongest human height axis in this file, and the only one that BREAKS THE BONE-AGE TRADE. Loss of PRC2 gives supranormal ADULT height DESPITE 100 per cent advanced bone age - mean +3.5 SD, replicated across THREE subunits as three separate overgrowth syndromes - and the Weaver mutations are PARTIAL loss of function, which is exactly what a drug does. The drug exists. It is also the wrong drug for this subject, and the reason is the same bone age

ROUND 282 - the operator supplied the paper I asked for and it splits cleanly in two. THE HEMIZYGOUS MALE REPLICATES - same variant, different country, predicted adult height +2.75 SDS above his own midparental target, with BONE AGE NOT ADVANCED AT TANNER 5. THE FEMALE CARRIERS DO NOT - the only attained ADULT heights in this whole class now point in opposite directions in two families carrying the identical allele, so that claim is withdrawn. And the paper measured the thing nobody had measured: the Wnt-lowering state costs BONE, in humans, and the cost is CORTICAL - readable for free off the bone-age film we already take

ROUND 330 - the operator-supplied richard2025 supplements opened for the first time. They give the first SITE-RESOLVED human integration of chromatin, expression and height GWAS per individual growth plate. NPR3 turns out to be an almost private regulatory feature of the DISTAL FEMUR - accessibility 0.93 and GWAS 0.94 there against 0.08 or less at all seven other sites - and the atlas's own CORR-299 postnatal test then kills it, because NPR3 is 5/14 at 1.63 CPM in postnatal growth plate. What survives both tests is HHIP, STC2 and PAPPA

R413: the missing step - join the blind-spot list to the 3,034 conditionally independent height GWAS variants and 140 of them acquire a SIGNED effect in centimetres. The headline is SERPINA1: the alpha-1-antitrypsin DEFICIENCY allele adds +1.19 cm per copy at -log10P 130, the gene is 1,606 CPM and cartilage-enriched with zero atlas coverage, and a clinical-stage agent that lowers it already exists

R416: search from RESTRAINT instead of investment - Table S3 gives 34 CODING loss-of-function variants that RAISE height, i.e. brakes with a READABLE direction, and the table validates itself by re-finding this file's own targets. The one large novel entry, LRRC58 at +5.20 cm with zero atlas coverage, is worked to a conclusion and does NOT promote - and the reason is a new failure mode: a gene is not a unit of function
Searched rather than greped - the heterochronic microRNA layer, and LIN28/let-7 is the one axis that moves both terms with one perturbation

ROUND 199 - EVERY ROUTE TO EXPANDING THE BUDGET, ENUMERATED - the budget is not a mammalian constant, a deer runs the same tissue 365 times faster on a renewable pool, and the delivery technology the atlas said did not exist was published this year

ROUND 201 - human resting-zone arrest is imposed and reversible, waking the pool does not make columns, and the deiodinase-thyroid-Notch axis that guards the reserve in muscle is resting-zone specific in the human growth plate

ROUND 248 - YES, POOL EXPANSION IS POSSIBLE AND IT HAS BEEN DONE. Hedgehog agonism after SOC formation raises the resting pool 2.1-fold with proliferation and terminal cell size UNCHANGED and gives an ACCUMULATING length gain. And the delivery problem the ledger called the recommended next dive was solved in 2026 by a growth-plate-targeting nanoparticle carrying a hedgehog agonist. THE GATE IS NOW THE MOLECULE, NOT THE MECHANISM

ROUND 249 - the three asks closed. The contradiction was an uncited review sentence (CORR-259). THE ELEVATION TEST WAS ALREADY DONE AND IT IS POSITIVE - normal Wistar-Kyoto rats, contralateral control, +3.63 per cent femur. And SAG DOWNREGULATES WNT AS ONE OF ITS TOP TWO PATHWAYS, which means hedgehog agonism expands the pool BY INSTALLING THE ROOT-CELL BRAKE rounds 241 and 245 characterised

ROUND 251 - newton2019 read in full. THE SECOND SIGNAL IS HEDGEHOG WITHDRAWAL: vismodegib forced the alerted Tsc1 pool to differentiate directly into columnar cells. The resting zone sits where SHH from the SOC meets IHH from the hypertrophic zone, which is why an intra-SOC bead works. And Newton's own colony-forming assay finds NO change in stem cell number under hedgehog, which downgrades the expansion reading

ROUND 252 - the mTORC1 length experiment FOUND, and the answer reframes the ceiling. Tsc1-null cartilage grows 52 PER CENT FASTER EX VIVO AND NOT AT ALL IN VIVO. THE BLOCK ON GROWTH IS EXTRINSIC TO THE PLATE - which converges with two other things this atlas already held. And ambrosi2025 delivers a human two-drug combination that maps onto the root-cell brake from a completely independent direction

ROUND 276 - the biggest item on the live frontier, attacked and CLOSED ON MECHANISM. DNMT1's most significant human association is HEIGHT at P < 4.2e-35 and losing it SHORTENS bone by accelerating differentiation. But blocking demethylation the other way, by IDH mutation, ALSO costs longitudinal growth - cells divert into enchondroma instead. DNA methylation is a BAND, and every available epigenetic agent pushes the wrong way. Two concrete contraindications fall out

ROUND 281 - I TESTED ROUND 280 AND IT BROKE. The exact human Weaver allele, put into a mouse, gives ZERO bone length. PRC2 loss AT THE PLATE SHORTENS. So does the Sotos gene, and its own authors say so. FOUR GENES OF THE OVERGROWTH CLASS FAIL AT THE GROWTH PLATE - AND THE FIFTH, THE ONE THIS FILE HAD ONLY EVER SEEN AS A NAME IN A TABLE, IS THE CLEANEST POOL LEVER IN THE ATLAS. SPIN4 loss expands the RESTING ZONE, raises tibia length at two weeks, ten weeks and EIGHTEEN MONTHS, leaves terminal hypertrophic cell height untouched, and works through the exact mechanism this atlas has had an open gap on since round 182 - lowered canonical Wnt in resting chondrocytes. There is no SPIN4 drug. The compound that reaches its pathway implements the wrong half of it and the paper reporting it watched a growth plate fuse

R399: the one field built to expand a stem cell pool had zero coverage here - asked properly it does not transfer, because every one of its drugs was built for the BLOOD stem cell; and the two shelves that DO reach cartilage both point the wrong way

R400: turning Notch ON - four independent lines say Notch holds the reserve, the textbook reason it could not be drugged with a soluble agonist stopped being true in 2024, and a Jagged1 peptide has ALREADY been injected into mice and expanded an endogenous progenitor pool in bone without a caliper being used

R423: amplification is the atlas's own declared primary target, 88 percent of the yield, and R174/R175/ R177 never reached CLAUDE.md. The one named druggable circuit that could deliver R175's drug spec is the SIK3-HDAC4 arm - and run through Step 0 properly it CLOSES on six independent grounds, the strongest of which is that its own literature states its purpose is to MIMIC PTH, and PTH1R agonism already returned 0.0 percent terminal femoral length in every arm

ROUTE 1 MAPPED - five stem populations with no established hierarchy, a Hedgehog lever whose sign depends on developmental STAGE rather than duration, a charge-and-discharge pair sitting unexploited inside one paper, and a contested sign on GH

What actually ends growth is not a spent cell count - it is a maintenance-methylation leak specific to slow replication inside the niche, and the one in vivo rejuvenation experiment pushes it the wrong way

ROUND 284 - the human genetics of the GHSR axis came in and it runs the RIGHT way: 26 people with heterozygous loss are short with LOW IGF-I and a NORMAL stimulated GH peak. That validates the direction of the compound sitting at the top of this file's LIVE list - and it is also the reason that compound CANNOT BE ADDED to this stack. A secretagogue works through the pituitary; exogenous GH bypasses it. The one argument that made LUM-201 an ADDITION rather than a SUBSTITUTION was pulsatility, and round 271 already tested that prediction and it failed. Three unchecked compounds closed in the same round

R419: the androgen axis has 106 files, a full oxandrolone node and a human ADULT-HEIGHT meta-analysis, and CLAUDE.md has never mentioned it once. Worked, it kills the raise-oestradiol hypothesis on two independent human lines, exposes a TARGET-ENGAGEMENT problem with aromatase inhibition started in late puberty, shows that MALE growth-plate chondrocytes convert testosterone to DHT rather than oestradiol, and produces a clinically live contraindication that pairs with minoxidil

R420: the androgen arm worked to the end. This atlas's own androgen_receptor node CLOSED it on a misread of the CAIS evidence and a rat null that tested the wrong ligand in fetal tissue. Reopened, the arm is REAL, DIRECT, MALE-SPECIFIC and DHT-MEDIATED, and a 46,XY human without a functional AR loses 1.9 cm/yr of peak height velocity and ends 0.6 SD below male norms. It still does not open a lever here - the human dose-response is EXTINGUISHED AFTER AGE 16 - but it hardens finasteride and dutasteride from a mechanistic guess into a measured result in the target cell type

Round 347 - R344 purity-corrected 72 genes by hand; run genome-wide it returns 301 abundant cartilage-enriched genes with ZERO atlas coverage, and the best of them is ECRG4, a secreted furin-cleaved senescence signal whose knockout mouse is longer at P=4.45e-07 with normal weight and HIGHER bone density; plus the one-carbon axis, which is the obtainable inverse of a hypomethylating agent

Round 356 - the POOL round. The genome-wide resting-zone contrast, run for the first time on human tissue, returns SMOC1 - and the resting zone's own programme is three secreted canonical-Wnt antagonists

R412: the 1,492 blind spots cluster into THREE replicated zonal programmes - a 76-gene HYPERTROPHIC-ZONE programme with zero atlas coverage whose top member PANX3 rises 180-fold and has a cryo-EM structure, a 46-gene reserve programme, and a 17-gene proliferative one - plus a self-correction to R366's antifungal advice
R437 - the process decomposition, and the answer to "processes that have never been observed"

ROUND 286 - I listed FBN1 as UNTESTED one round ago and this atlas already held the decisive datum, in a paper the operator supplied in August. Marfan long-bone overgrowth is NORMAL AT BIRTH AND DIVERGES BETWEEN ONE AND THREE MONTHS - the largest human taller-gene, +11.14 cm per allele, accrues ENTIRELY POSTNATALLY. So TWO of round 283's six now pass the open-plate test, and BOTH ARE SECRETED EXTRACELLULAR ANTAGONISTS ACTING FROM OUTSIDE THE RESPONDING CELL - which is CORR-300's rule arrived at a second time, independently

ROUND 288 - I took the perichondrial axis apart because it was the only one of the four with an approved molecule. THIS ATLAS SAID THE HUMAN TEST COULD NEVER BE RUN. IT HAS BEEN RUN FOUR TIMES WITH A TRUE CONTROL - AIMS IS PLACEBO-CONTROLLED, AGES 6-40, MEDIAN 18, FIVE YEARS, AND COMPUTED BSA-ADJUSTED Z SCORES ANNUALLY, WHICH REQUIRES SERIAL HEIGHT. But the same trial reports that irbesartan did not move circulating TGF-beta at all, no TGF-beta-lowering agent has ever had bone length measured in a normal animal, and the one unexplored lead inside the mechanism paper points AWAY from its own available compounds

ROUND 289 - operator supplied all three. The AIMS appendix DOWNGRADES my own round-288 claim: height is nowhere in it, only WEIGHT is demonstrably serial, and the TGF-beta null I leaned on is p=0.18 with the point estimate in the drug's favour - UNDERPOWERED, NOT NULL. What the appendix does deliver is 93 CHILDREN UNDER 18, RANDOMISED, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED, FIVE YEARS. And two more labs had growing animals on this exact axis and measured weight and bone mass instead of length. Three labs, three chances, no caliper. Then the argument that actually decides it for this case - the axis grows LIMBS

ROUND 311 - the genome-wide CRISPR screen of chondrocyte maturation is UNBLOCKED, its sign convention calibrated on nine controls, and it answers a question the atlas has never been able to ask - which genes set the PERIOD. Its informative direction is ACCELERATION, which makes it a CONTRAINDICATION screen; and the genes it cannot see are exactly the secreted extracellular layer the atlas's two best leads live in, which it proves by reporting the inside nodes of hedgehog and missing the outside one

ROUND 312 - a growth-capacity discriminator built from two orthogonal contrasts in two species, and the answer to what should be ADDED. HHIP is 2.3-3.3 log2 higher in the LOW-OUTPUT plate in BOTH mouse and rat with matching magnitude; CHAD replicates on both axes and carries +2.63 cm of human burden effect; LOXL2 runs the WRONG WAY in rat; and NRK's expression contradicts the direction its own human genetics imply. No candidate emerges that has both a real mechanism and an obtainable molecule
The FGFR axis is defensible and the spine fear was overstated — but erdafitinib specifically cannot be dosed into the window
Every axis in the height equation, checked one at a time against the four-drug stack - what is hit, what is not, and what compound hits the rest
Every documented drug on the CNP axis, enumerated by intervention point - and the pick changes because navepegritide is now approved and the CNP-plus-GH combination has been run
THE LEDGER - every thread and axis sorted into dead, settled, or live, with the reason each one sits where it does
NPR2 POSITIVE ALLOSTERIC MODULATION - raise the receptor's gain instead of delivering more ligand, with a human dose-response in standing height and a small molecule that already exists
RESVERATROL - the compound this atlas never touched, on the highest-ranked arm, with a final-length endpoint from the laboratory that killed tamoxifen
ROUND 194 - the FDA review tabulates femoral length per age window and finds it identical in every arm at terminal sacrifice, and the receptor is on the pre-hypertrophic cell rather than on the pool
ROUND 196 - the pair-fed experiment exists and it is a uraemia rescue, the mirror experiment moves nothing at the plate, and a wild-type growing mouse gives six length nulls at once

ROUND 208 - restoration is not elevation, GH has no demonstrated h_term effect above a normal baseline, no combination study measuring terminal cell height exists anywhere, and FGFR3 inhibition grows the sites the CNP axis misses

ROUND 250 - systemic SAG audited term by term, and the real gate is not safety. IT IS FLUX. The atlas already showed in round 201 that mTORC1-on and short-course hedgehog agonism produce THE SAME SHAPE - a bigger pool that does not discharge - and the one direct manipulation of division MODE changed recruitment NOT AT ALL, which is exactly what round 247's algebra predicted

ROUND 258 - the compound question is settled and CD2665 is not the answer. The class distinction was made in 1996 and structurally resolved in 2009; an RARgamma-SELECTIVE INVERSE AGONIST exists and has been run once, in Xenopus, in a five-arm reciprocal design in which ENHANCING unliganded RARgamma repression MAINTAINS A PROGENITOR POOL AND EXTENDS THE BODY AXIS while reducing it TERMINATES AXIAL ELONGATION PREMATURELY - and that also explains away the standing yamaguchi1998 objection

ROUND 259 - CD2665 CLASSIFIED, and the answer is subtype-split. At RARgamma it CANNOT DISSOCIATE SMRT - it preserves the co-repressor-bound state - while at RARalpha it strips SMRT and can COOPERATE WITH A REXINOID TO ACTIVATE. And the compound that should be used instead already exists, is RARgamma-selective, raises SOX9 and proteoglycan in chondrogenic cells, and is already in nanoparticles from the same laboratory

ROUND 296 - "not actionable" was asserted in round 295 without a compound search, which is failure mode four. Search run. Six compound classes on the volume axis return NO mammalian bone-length endpoint. The PIEZO1 lead I promoted yesterday is refuted by a node this atlas has held since 6 August - its agonist causes cartilage degeneration and its blockade is the therapeutic direction. And the one genuine compound found is a human randomised trial that buys 0.84 cm and pays for it in bone age

ROUND 297 - the inverse audit. Instead of sweeping the literature for compounds, sweep THIS FILE for accessible drugs it has never once mentioned. Across 821 nodes and 1,597 references, 30 obtainable agents return zero hits. That is a different and more tractable kind of gap than "no molecule exists", which is where HHIP and the whole volume axis ended up. Four of the thirty have a mechanism that touches a term of the height identity, and the best of them targets the PERIOD

ROUND 298 - the exhaustive version. Round 297 audited 39 drugs I chose from memory. This runs all 298 targets the atlas has ever named against every drug in Open Targets: 948 drug-target pairs and 419 approved agents this file has never written down. Then four candidate pathways were tested against the human growth plate before any of them was proposed - and THREE DIED WITHIN THE HOUR. What survives is two contraindications, one of them a drug currently given to boys

ROUND 301 - the deep pass on what to actually ADD to this stack. Sacubitril is ELIMINATED by the four-arm design in the very paper that promoted it. Losartan is DEPRIORITISED, not eliminated - my first draft said eliminated and CORR-326 retracts it. Both fail for one underlying reason, now three-for-three: THE HUMAN GROWTH PLATE CARRIES THE RECEIVER AND NOT THE DRUGGED UPSTREAM NODE. What survives is LOXL2, and CXXC5 - the operator's standing question - gets the strongest expression result in the round

ROUND 302 - the operator changed the grading rule: mechanical plausibility without a documented length endpoint is a GAP, not a disqualification. Re-triaged under that rule, and the winner is the experiment ROUND 281 ALREADY NAMED and never followed up. Tankyrase is IN the human growth plate - both paralogues, both donors, never checked before today. Tankyrase inhibition LOWERS beta-catenin in HUMAN chondrocytes and is chondro-ANABOLIC. And the class's fatal gut toxicity was engineered out: basroparib is tankyrase-selective, oral, and finished first-in-human with NO dose-limiting toxicities

ROUND 303 - tankyrase taken all the way down. The atlas said "no tankyrase inhibitor has a bone-length endpoint in any species" and the GENETIC length endpoint was sitting in the operator-supplied IMPC file the whole time. Tnks-null mice: body length UNCHANGED, tibia nominally SHORTER, bone mineral severely DOWN. But Axin2-het - the clean opposite-direction test - is body length -1.98 at P=9e-05, which validates the direction. Both are true and they resolve. Plus the dose chain, computed as far as it goes

ROUND 304 - I extracted every bone-length endpoint in IMPC (7,216 genes, 12,068 rows) and the first thing it did was break ROUND 303. Knockout mice are SHORTER 64% of the time and 245:38 among significant hits, so both my validating result (Axin2) and my invalidating one (Tnks tibia) dissolve into the base rate. What survives the correction is the rare direction - and the single largest lengthening knockout in the entire dataset is PDE3B, which has an approved oral drug and a concordant human effect at P=5e-13

ROUND 313 - the compound hunt run properly instead of asserted. CHAD does NOT have zero chemical matter: it has a mapped active motif, a cyclic peptide mimetic and in vivo mouse dosing, and I claimed otherwise off a single Open Targets query. Its direction is wrong, which names the exact molecule nobody has made. And the connectivity-map route - the one approach that bypasses druggability entirely - is structurally blocked for the same reason the CRISPR screen was

ROUND 316 - the immediately actionable item is not a compound to add but a HEIGHT COST probably being paid right now. rhGH LOWERS free T4, the size of that fall predicts a WORSE growth response, and this subject is on GH with his thyroid status unrecorded anywhere in this atlas. One blood draw decides it and four other open questions at the same time

ROUND 320 - A COMPOUND. The sulfate arm was dismissed in round 295 because SLC13A1 and SLC26A1 are absent from the human growth plate - but those are the RENAL transporters. The CARTILAGE one is SLC26A2, and it is present at 118 CPM in up to 82% of cells with the entire sulfation machinery behind it. The receiver test passes, Step 0 passes, the human dose-response is graded across the population, and the agent - N-acetylcysteine - has a demonstrated human effect on the exact biomarker

ROUND 321 - the sulfate arm taken all the way down. The compound is ORAL SODIUM SULFATE, not NAC: 9 g raised serum inorganic sulfate 25% in EIGHT HEALTHY ADULTS, which is elevation in replete humans and answers CORR-203 directly. The authoritative review confirms chondrocytes draw their sulfate mainly from the EXTRACELLULAR space. And a single ordinary 1.5 g dose of PARACETAMOL drops serum sulfate 24%

ROUND 322 - the sulfate question CLOSED with scherer2025's own supplementary tables. Sulfate is causally upstream of human height and it is TRUNK-SPECIFIC - SLC13A1 loss hits SITTING height at P=2.2e-07 against standing height at 0.0064. The gradient is ~0.10 SD of sitting height per SD of plasma sulfate. But the same paper's physiology defeats the supplement: capacity-limited renal reabsorption exists to hold sulfate CONSTANT, so lowering the set point genetically and raising it with a dose are NOT symmetric

ROUND 323 - round 304 ended with an instruction to the next round ("None assessed. Start the next round here, from data") and rounds 305-322 all went somewhere else. The 69 lengthening knockouts are now assessed, the HPO files are opened for the first time, and BOTH independent screens land on the SAME axis - perichondrial TGF-beta. Plus two measured negatives that stop the next round repeating this work, and one paywalled number that decides the whole thing

ROUND 324 - NRK/NESK taken as deep as the evidence goes. THE HUMAN GENETICS ARE THE BEST IN THIS ATLAS - a graded allelic series, pLoF > deleterious missense > possibly deleterious missense > all missense, monotone in severity AND in rarity, best P = 6.4e-29. THE MECHANISM EXISTS AND IT IS AKT. THE KNOCKOUT MOUSE EXISTS AND ITS SKELETON WAS NEVER LOOKED AT. AND THE MODALITY IS WRONG - NRK's antiproliferative function is KINASE-INDEPENDENT, so an ATP-competitive inhibitor of the atlas's favourite "most drugged fold there is" would probably do nothing

ROUND 325 - PTPN9 / PTP-MEG2. THE OPERATOR IS RIGHT ABOUT THE COMPOUND: `zhang2012meg2`'s compound 7 is Ki 34 nM, >18-fold selective, CELL PERMEABLE, and works in mice at 5 mg/kg twice daily - the best chemical matter attached to any target in this atlas, by a wide margin.
